rules: Keep established archive card, body, lightbox and context-menu interactions. Exact native archive manifest, post and asset identity; never admit an arbitrary frontend file path.
Downloaded images use SauceNAO; downloaded videos use their saved poster with Google Lens. No active X login is required to search local pixels. No silent change from thumbnail to current frame.
Preserve provider order, title, creator field, exact numeric score, metadata and bounded sanitized preview. A search match is not proof of authorship.
Retain the same provider browser after complete, empty and failed extraction; explicit original-page opening must not upload again. Expire after30minutes and close on cancel/stale context/shutdown.

Known original post and indexed X-result post can request profile-declared links separately. Read only profile header/bio/website, preserve unresolved short links, and never imply that the searched work exists at the linked site.
The original-post profile action can run before image-search consent; it does not upload the image or alter that consent.
Preserve finite resource limits, explicit search consent, provider session isolation and stale/account/privacy cancellation. Root alone performs a short UI batch; agents analyze and test offline.

limitations: Downloaded video source search requires its saved poster; it does not silently substitute a decoded frame.
Search services can return weak matches, block a request or change structure. Preserve their data and expose the original page rather than claiming a verified source.
A profile-declared external link does not establish that the selected work is posted on that service.
